description: Get total edit counts for a Wikimedia project over a date range, bucketed daily or monthly. Filter by editor type (anonymous, group-bot, name-bot, user, or all-editor-types) and page type (content, non-content, or all-page-types). Data: Wikimedia Analytics REST API (wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1), no auth required.

project.description: Wikimedia project domain (e.g. en.wikipedia, de.wikipedia, commons.wikimedia)

name: wikimedia-analytics.edits.aggregate

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Wikipedia Edit Count Aggregate
